name: Fred Kaplan Trio
aliases: Happy hour w/ Fred Kaplan Trio
bio: Fred Kaplan is a blues pianist whose career goes back to the early 1970s, when he helped form the Hollywood Fats Band. He records and tours as a solo pianist and as a sideman and producer for blues artists, and his trio plays Friday evenings at The Grape in Ventura.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from fredkaplanmusic.com and @fredkaplanmusic.
